newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ionica plans London stock exchange listing.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ionica plans London stock exchange listing.

text.p: British telephone operator Ionica said on Wednesday that it plans to seek a listing on the London stock exchange and also wants its shares quoted on Nasdaq in the U.S.

The company said that the proceeds raised from the flotation will provide further funding for the expansion of its network. It has so far raised 400 million stg in private equity placements, debt offerings and secured bank financing to fund development.
Ionica has a national licence to provide telephone services for residential and small business customers in the UK with the exception of Scotland.

"Ionica's aim is to become the principal national alternative consumer telephone service. We are floating now to raise additional funds for the expansion of our network," said chief executive Nigel Playford.
It expects the prospectus to be available later this month. SBC Warburg is sponsor and global co-ordinator of the flotation.
Ionica, partly-owned by Yorkshire Electricity Plc and Northern Electric Plc, has a national licence and plans to cover three-quarters of homes in England and Wales by 2000.
